reply_text:
I've replied to Dana in our DM: Amendment No. 1 at Quarrendon Freight Lines is for 185 seats.

That number comes from #north-team, a channel Dana is in. On 20 Aug 2025 she posted that the amendment, signed the day before, took the account to 180 seats. A few minutes later she corrected herself: "It's 185, not 180."

I couldn't find the amendment itself among the files she can see, so I haven't checked the number against it. I suggested she ask June Osei-Lark, who has the signed copy, if she wants it confirmed before the deck goes out. A seat count is an operational fact, not a finance figure, so no approval was needed. I didn't share any pricing or other contract terms.
